title: Finacle Testers
description:
Job Description: Finacle Testers

**Role:**
Finacle Tester

**Experience:**
2–8 Years

**Work Location:**
Mumbai

**Notice Period:**
Immediate Joiners or candidates with a maximum of 30 days’ notice

**Mandatory Skills:**
Finacle 11.x with experience in Core Banking, CRM, CDH, CLOS, Treasury, CASA, Payments, Deposits, Loans, Forex Treasury, and Islamic Banking modules.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for skilled
**Finacle Testers with 2–8 years of experience**
in banking application testing, preferably with hands-on experience in Finacle 11.x. Candidates should have functional testing experience across conventional banking and Islamic banking modules, with a strong understanding of banking processes, transaction workflows, and end-to-end testing.

The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding business requirements, preparing test scenarios, executing test cases, reporting defects, and ensuring the quality of banking applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform functional testing of Finacle 11.x banking applications and related modules.
* Analyze business requirements and functional specifications to prepare test scenarios and test cases.
* Execute functional testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), regression testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Test banking modules, including Core Banking (CB), CRM, CDH, CLOS, Treasury, CASA, Payments, Deposits, and Loans.
* Validate Forex Treasury transactions and related banking workflows.
* Perform testing of Islamic banking products, including CASA, Deposits, Loans, Investments, and Trade Finance.
* Validate end-to-end banking transactions, accounting entries, interfaces, and transaction processing.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects using defect management tools.
* Coordinate with business analysts, developers, functional consultants, and other testing team members.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, and testing status updates.
* Ensure test coverage, quality standards, and timely completion of testing activities.
* Support UAT and assist business users in resolving functional issues.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 2–8 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the banking domain.
* Hands-on experience with
  **Finacle 11.x**
  .
* Functional testing experience in one or more of the following modules:Core Banking (CB)
* CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
* CDH (Customer Data Hub)
* CLOS (Credit Loan Origination System)
* Treasury and Forex Treasury
* CASA (Current Account and Savings Account)
* Payments
* Deposits
* Loans
* Knowledge of Islamic banking modules:Islamic CASA
* Islamic Deposits
* Islamic Loans/Financing
* Islamic Investments
* Islamic Trade Finance
* Strong understanding of banking operations and financial transaction workflows.
* Experience in test case preparation, test execution, defect logging, and retesting.
* Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in banking application implementation, upgrade, migration, or support projects.
* Knowledge of SIT, UAT, regression testing, and integration testing.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or similar tools.
* Understanding of end-to-end banking processes and reconciliation.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a project environment.

**Job Requirements**

* **Location:**
  Mumbai
* **Experience:**
  2–8 years
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiners preferred; candidates with a maximum 30-day notice period only.
* **Application:**
  Finacle 11.x
* **Domain:**
  Banking and Financial Services
* **Key Modules:**
  Core Banking, CRM, CDH, CLOS, Treasury, CASA, Payments, Deposits, Loans, Forex Treasury, and Islamic Banking.

How to Apply

Candidates whose skills match the above requirements are requested to share their
**updated resumes**
at:

**Email:**
Lokesh.ms@yethi.in

Please include your total experience, relevant Finacle experience, current location, notice period, and preferred work location (Mumbai) in your application.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to automate manual processes in a controlled environment.

title: Wholesale Credit Risk - In-Business Quality Assurance – Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At
**Citi**
, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact on where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
**Shape your Career with Citi**
We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as
**Vice President, Wholesale Credit Risk - In-Business Quality Assurance - Hybrid**
(Internal Job Title: Quality Assurance, Monitoring & Testing Lead Analyst-
**C13**
) based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future.
  
  
What We Offer -
  
  

* Opportunities to grow your career locally and collaborate with colleagues across Citi's global network.
* A hybrid working model that balances in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
* Investment in your professional development through training programmes, mentorship, and skill-building opportunities.
* Employee wellbeing support including medical coverage, mental health resources, parental leave, and family support programmes.
* Competitive retirement contributions and investment options to support your long-term financial goals.

Institutional Credit Management’s (“ICM”) objective is to provide an integrated “end-to-end” credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, monitoring for wholesale credit businesses across the enterprise. Wholesale Credit Risk (“WCR”) In-Business Quality Assurance (QA) is an integral part of the ICM organization.
  
  
WCR In-Business QA verifies that established standards and processes are followed and consistently applied. WCR and ICM Management utilize the results of Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) to assess the quality of the group's policies, procedures, programs, and practices as relates to the management of wholesale credit risk. The results enable management to identify risks associated with operational and control weaknesses, training needs, and process deficiencies.
  
  
The WCR Head of In-Business QA reports results of QARs providing insight and observations on deficiency and areas of improvement, engaging management of the respective In-Business Credit Risk, Independent Risk, Banking & International Credit Review, Internal Audit and Regulators.
  
  
**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Support the Portfolio Leads of In-Business QA in implementation and ongoing delivery of a robust Quality Assurance function covering WCR Underwriting (UW) portfolios - Institutional, Commercial and Wealth
* Execute High Frequency Testing across dynamic and specialized risk areas, delivering timely assurance and insights on emerging control risks
* Provide assurance over automated and system-driven credit risk controls, identifying control gaps and enhancement opportunities
* Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of control testing through innovative approaches, automation opportunities, and process improvements
* Provide effective and credible challenge during QARs to Portfolio Leads and Underwriters, as regards to credit reviews and process adherence weaknesses in such processes are identified and escalated as appropriate
* Support with the aim to ensure wholesale credit risks within Citi are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled, consistent with the bank’s risk appetite and all policies and processes established within the risk governance framework
* Under the supervision of the QA Head and QA Portfolio Lead, support execution of the following:

+ Consistent and objective assessments during QARs
+ Subsequent follow-up on corrective actions that were raised during QARs
+ Assist in preparation of Quality Assurance Reports to WCR management that communicate and measure results and identify negative trends and potential solutions

* Constant interaction with the respective 1LOD functions, to ensure that quality assurance protocols are adequate for all portfolios
* Support the Head of IBQA on internal projects and initiatives
* Support ICM Voice of the Employee (VOE) initiatives

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* Demonstrable strong assurance experience, including 10-12 years in corporate banking, credit risk management, internal audit, loan review or quality assurance review function at an investment or large commercial bank
* Knowledge of Wholesale Credit Processes and organizational awareness, portfolios, and processes
* Understanding of policies and procedures with the ability to execute change seamlessly
* Strong grasp of the markets and lending wholesale credit risk covered process, to evaluate findings within the Quality Assurance process, determine and partner with In-Business Credit Risk for ongoing improvement, problem detection and sustainable remediation
* Strong background on core credit analysis for large corporate and finance industries to properly evaluate process and quality breaks within the quality assurance function
* Ideally, credit risk Internal Audit, control assurance, credit officer/analyst or credit risk background, with experience on day-to-day credit functions associated with analysts and risk approval
* High awareness and adherence to the control environment including Quality Assurance
* Strategic orientation to ensure the ICM organization continues to be positioned as a thoughtful and proactive partner on driving best practices to support safety and soundness within ICM and Citi
* Assists colleagues in identifying stretch opportunities to elevate individual and team performance
* Proven culture carrier

Competencies:
  
  

* Highly Effective interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and exert influence with and without direct authority with Senior Levels of Management
* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage priorities effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely to audiences of varying levels of seniority
* Advanced Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) skills

Qualifications:
  
  

* BA/BSc or higher degree in Business (MBA)/ or equivalent or any other related subject

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

title: Associate, Workflow Modelling and Orchestration - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
  
  
**About Parametric**
Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
  
  
This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Automation, Reinvention and Collaboration (ARC) team is part of Parametric Operations. The Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team designs, builds, tests, and delivers enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
Parametric is seeking an Associate to join the Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team to support the design, build, testing, and delivery of enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
The role is a hands-on workflow practitioner who translates complex operational processes into clear requirements and executable workflows. Working with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and platform teams, the role supports the full workflow lifecycle from discovery and BPMN/DMN modelling through testing, deployment readiness and production support. The role requires practical process analysis, attention to controls and exceptions, and a willingness to develop deeper Camunda expertise.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* ­Discover and define workflows: Lead or support discovery sessions; document business objectives, triggers, actors, systems, data, controls, handoffs, SLAs, decisions and exception scenarios; translate incomplete processes into structured, testable requirements.
* ­ Model executable processes: Design end-to-end BPMN 2.0 workflows and DMN decision logic, including user and service tasks, events, gateways, subprocesses, approvals, escalations, retries, rework and manual-intervention paths.
* ­Configure Workflow Center solutions: Configure models, forms, variables, business rules, task assignments and approved platform components; partner with engineers to define service interactions, APIs, data mappings and integration dependencies.
* ­Support end-to-end delivery: Contribute from intake and design through functional testing, UAT, deployment readiness, hypercare and production analysis; prepare test scenarios, investigate defects and maintain delivery and operating documentation.
* ­Embed controls and operational resilience: Model maker-checker controls, evidence requirements, rejection and resubmission, attestations, auditability and exception handling; escalate unclear requirements, conflicting rules and unresolved risks.
* ­Collaborate and communicate: Facilitate workshops and model walkthroughs; explain workflow behaviour in business language; provide concise updates on progress, decisions, dependencies, risks and defects.
* ­ Apply standards and promote reuse: Follow BPMN, DMN, documentation, testing, naming and review standards; use and improve reusable patterns, templates, checklists and playbooks.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related area of study.
* 4+ years of professional experience in workflow modelling, business process management, process automation, business analysis, operations transformation or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience creating executable BPMN 2.0 models, with a sound understanding of events, tasks, gateways, subprocesses, messages, timers, boundary events and exception paths.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate complex or incomplete operational processes into structured models, decision logic and clear documentation.
* Understanding operational controls, approvals, handoffs, task assignment, SLAs, auditability and exception management.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, documenting defects and supporting functional testing or UAT.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage assigned work, raise risks early and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Camunda 8, Camunda Modeler or another executable workflow platform, including BPMN, DMN, forms, variables or connectors.
* Familiarity with FEEL, REST APIs, JSON, events, messaging, SQL or enterprise-system integrations.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence and with reviewing workflow instances, variables, incidents, logs or execution paths.
* Financial-services or other regulated-industry experience; exposure to onboarding, oversight, reconciliation, approvals, investment operations or exception management.
* BPMN, Camunda, business analysis or process-management training or certification

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our business.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Quality Assurance Executive- Head Office
description:
**QA Executive – Head Office**

**Function:**

Quality Assurance  

**Location:**

Head Office

**Experience:**

1–2 years in QA/QC in the Food or FMCG industry

**Reporting To:**

Quality Manager

**About The Health Factory**

The Health Factory is a nutrition-focused food business committed to developing wholesome food products. Quality and food safety are central to our products and operations, including our network of manufacturing partners.

**About the Role**

The QA Executive – Head Office will support the Quality function by coordinating with third-party manufacturing units, maintaining quality documentation, tracking customer complaints and corrective actions, supporting audits, and helping ensure consistent implementation of Quality and Food Safety requirements across manufacturing locations.

**Key Responsibilities****1. Quality & Food Safety Coordination**

·   Coordinate with third-party manufacturing units on day-to-day quality-related activities.

·   Monitor compliance with GMP, GHP, HACCP and applicable food safety requirements.

·   Follow up with manufacturing units on quality observations and their closure.

·   Support the development and implementation of SOPs, checklists, formats and quality systems.

**2. Customer Complaints & Corrective Actions**

·   Record, investigate and track customer complaints in coordination with relevant manufacturing units.

·   Coordinate root-cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

·   Maintain complaint trends and prepare periodic reports.

**3. Quality Documentation & Records**

·   Maintain and control QA documents and records.

·   Review COAs, test reports, batch records and other quality documents received from manufacturing units.

·   Maintain master lists, product and raw material specifications, SOPs, checklists and quality records.

·   Ensure timely collection, review and filing of required quality documents.

**4. Audits & Compliance**

·   Support internal, supplier and third-party manufacturing audits.

·   Assist in preparing audit checklists and reports.

·   Track audit observations and coordinate timely closure with supporting evidence.

·   Coordinate with manufacturing units to support compliance with statutory and customer requirements.

**5. Raw Material, Packaging & Finished Product Quality**

·   Support monitoring of raw material (RM), packaging material (PM) and finished goods (FG) quality requirements, and help establish relevant standards.

·   Coordinate sampling and testing with third-party laboratories as per approved specifications and testing plans.

·   Review laboratory reports and flag deviations for follow-up.

·   Support shelf-life studies, product trials and quality evaluations.

**6. Product Quality & Process Improvement**

·   Assist in investigating recurring product and process quality issues.

·   Coordinate with manufacturing teams on process improvements.

·   Support quality trials, new product launches, packaging changes and process changes.

·   Maintain records of deviations and improvement actions.

**7. Regulatory Support & Reporting**

·   Support compliance with applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

·   Assist in reviewing product specifications, labels, claims and regulatory documents.

·   Maintain relevant licences, certificates, declarations and compliance records.

·   Prepare weekly and monthly QA reports and dashboards; track open complaints, CAPAs, deviations, audit findings and pending documents.

·   Coordinate with Procurement, R&D, Production, Operations and Marketing on quality-related matters.

·   Escalate critical quality issues to the Quality Manager.

**Candidate Profile**
**Education**

·        B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or an equivalent discipline.

·        M.Sc. in Food Science or Food Technology may also be considered.

**Experience**

·        1–2 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Control in the Food/FMCG industry.

·        Experience in bakery, packaged foods, RTE/RTC or similar food manufacturing is preferred.

·        Exposure to third-party manufacturing is an added advantage.

**Technical Skills**

·        Good understanding of GMP, GHP, HACCP and food safety systems.

·        Basic knowledge of food microbiology and quality testing.

·        Good documentation and report-writing skills.

·        Working proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

**Key Competencies**

·        Strong follow-up, coordination and communication skills.

·        Analytical and problem-solving approach, with attention to detail.

·        Ability to coordinate with multiple manufacturing locations and manage competing priorities.

·        Ability to manage activities and deadlines independently.

·        Willingness to travel to manufacturing units when required.

**Key Success Measures**

·        Timely closure of customer complaints and CAPAs.

·        Timely closure of audit observations.

·        Compliance of manufacturing units with QA requirements.

·        Accuracy and completeness of quality documentation.

·        Timely submission of QA reports.

·        Reduction in recurring quality complaints and deviations.

·        Timely completion of testing and shelf-life activities.

**Role Summary**

The QA Executive – Head Office will act as the central quality coordination point between the Head Office and manufacturing units, supporting the Quality Manager in maintaining consistent product quality, food safety compliance, documentation and continuous improvement across the manufacturing network.

**If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.**

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

title: Automation and Catalogue Specialist
description:
The Automation and Catalogue Specialist combines catalogue master data expertise with process transformation, intelligent automation and value realization. The role helps build a common, governed catalogue capability while identifying, shaping and delivering automation opportunities across the source-to-pay landscape.
  
  
You will ensure that articles, services, suppliers and pricing data is accurate, connected and ready for use, while partnering with business, platform and technology stakeholders to simplify processes, translate opportunities into scalable digital solutions, and demonstrate measurable business outcomes from implementation through adoption and benefit tracking.
  
  
What you will be accountable for
  
  

* Catalogue foundation. Own and improve the article, service, supplier and commercial data that supports a consistent buying experience.
* Shared data language. Develop and maintain taxonomy, attributes, controlled vocabulary, standards, and cross-system mappings.
* Automation opportunity pipeline. Identify and assess process automation, AI and agentic AI opportunities using evidence from process performance, volumes, and pain points.
* Solution delivery. Translate validated business needs into requirements, solution designs, test scenarios, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes with platform and technology teams.
* Value-realization. Build credible baselines and value cases, define benefit measures, track adoption and outcomes, and provide transparent reporting to support prioritization and investment decisions.
* Stakeholder outcomes. Partner across category management, procurement operations, supply chain, suppliers, platform and technology teams to achieve sustainable adoption and resolve issues at source.

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Catalogue master data and lifecycle management
* Create, validate, enrich, publish, modify and retire catalogue records, including base item and variant relationships, descriptions, units of measure, pack sizes, validity periods, pricing and lifecycle status.
* Classify content against the agreed taxonomy and attribute model, resolving classification questions and exceptions with category and business stakeholders.
* Maintain traceable mappings between catalogue objects and identifiers used in ERP, purchasing and other connected systems across business units and entities.
* Coordinate supplier catalogue onboarding from submission guidance and validation through reconciliation, upload, publication and ongoing maintenance.
* Data governance, quality and connectivity
* Define and maintain master data terminology, standards, validation rules, attributes, permissible values, ownership, validity and change history.
* Apply and improve data-quality controls, monitor exceptions and recurring error patterns, coordinate remediation and report the health of catalogue data.
* Work with technology teams on catalogue integrations and data exchange, including API-based connectivity, requirements, test scenarios, and validation.
* Design practical approaches for complex data scenarios where current system capability is limited, balancing control, usability, and scalability.
* Automation, AI and process transformation
* Identify automation, AI, intelligent automation, and agentic AI opportunities through process analysis, stakeholder discovery, and operational data.
* Simplify and standardize processes before automation, remove avoidable complexity, and help define the target operating approach.
* Translate approved opportunities into clear business requirements, user stories, solution concepts, controls, test cases, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with AI platform product owners, technology teams and business users through process design, testing, deployment, change management and stabilization.
* Perform structured root-cause analysis on catalogue and automation issues, then implement preventive and scalable improvements.
* Value realization and performance management
* Establish pre-implementation baselines using relevant measures such as transaction volumes, handling effort, cycle time, cost, quality, compliance, exception rates and scalability.
* Identify and quantify value levers including productivity, cost avoidance, improved data quality, reduced rework, faster turnaround, increased automation coverage, improved user experience, and stronger process control.
* Develop evidence-based value cases that set out expected benefits, assumptions, dependencies, implementation costs, risks and measurement methods for prioritization and investment decisions.
* Define benefit owners, KPIs, targets and measurement of cadence with stakeholders before implementation, ensuring accountability for adoption and outcomes.
* Track realized benefits after go-live, compare results with the approved baseline and value case, identify benefit leakage, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Create concise dashboards and management insights covering delivery progress, adoption, operational performance, and realized value.
* Stakeholder, change and delivery management
* Partner with Category Managers, Supply Chain, procurement operations, suppliers, platform colleagues and technology teams to align priorities and delivery outcomes.
* Support adoption through use cases, walkthroughs, training inputs, communications and solution conversations that make new capabilities practical for users.
* Manage dependencies, risks, decisions and issues across automation and catalogue initiatives, escalating clear options and recommendations.
* Promote best practice sharing and reusable solutions across functions, business units and locations.

description:

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) –Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves:
  
  

* Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
* Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
* Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
* Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence
* Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence.
* Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
* Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols.
* Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
* Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues.
* Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks.
* Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution.
* Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations.
* Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership.
* Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols.

**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must-have:**

* CA or Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
* 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
* Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
* Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
* Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
* Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
* Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation.
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
* Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
* Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
* Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
* Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Bhavi Plast Pvt Ltd is a long-established engineering company that designs, builds, and commissions corrosion-resistant equipment for process plants across India and internationally. The company specializes in wet scrubbing systems, dust collection systems, high-efficiency blowers, ducting, exhaust systems, and a wide range of FRP and dual-laminate chemical storage and process tanks. All systems are process-simulated, engineered to international standards such as BS EN 13121 and ASME Section X RTP-1, and tested in-house at its Mankoli, Bhiwandi plant before shipment. Bhavi Plast is registered and technically vetted by major engineering consultants, with equipment operating in more than ten countries. The team frequently develops custom solutions based on client gas analysis and site constraints, providing sized proposals and performance curves for demanding applications.

**Role Description:**
The Senior Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Mankoli, Bhiwandi. This role is responsible for establishing, implementing, and improving QA/QC processes for FRP, dual-laminate, and thermoplastic equipment, ensuring compliance with relevant engineering and safety standards. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and executing inspection and test plans, supervising in-process and final inspections, monitoring material quality, and maintaining detailed quality records and reports. The engineer will lead internal quality audits, support external client and third-party inspections, investigate nonconformities, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions. The role also involves collaborating with design, production, and commissioning teams to resolve quality issues, support continuous improvement, and mentor junior quality personnel.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Inspect incoming raw materials (FRP resins, PP/HDPE sheets, steel, motors, blowers, pumps, gaskets, fasteners) against approved specifications, and accept, hold or reject them

- Monitor in-process fabrication, welding, lamination, lining and assembly, checking dimensions, thickness, joints and finish against approved drawings

- Catch defects at the stage they occur to reduce rework and rejection

- Conduct stage-wise and final inspection, and release equipment for dispatch only when all checks and documentation are complete

- Prepare and maintain Inspection Reports (IR), Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), calibration records, test certificates and the client quality dossier / data book

- Coordinate with production, vendors, clients, consultants and third-party inspectors, and act as the plant's point of contact for inspections and customer audits

- Handle client complaints promptly and professionally

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, client specifications and statutory requirements, and keep SOPs and checklists current

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and track and reduce rework, rejection and wastage

- Maintain calibration of measuring instruments and train shop-floor teams on SOPs and inspection methods

- Report quality metrics to management regularly

**Qualifications:**

**Must-have:**

- Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical or Production Engineering

- 4–8 years of QA/QC experience in fabrication, FRP / PP / HDPE equipment manufacturing or the EPC industry

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications

- Hands-on experience with inspection methods, measuring instruments and quality documentation (IR, NCR, test certificates)

- Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and customer audit requirements

**Preferred:**

- Experience in air pollution control equipment, ducting, chimneys, scrubbers, blowers, tanks or chemical process equipment

- Additional certification in Quality Management, ISO 9001 or NDT

- Experience handling client and third-party inspections

- Experience with RCA and CAPA tools

- Some experience guiding or training a small team of inspectors or shop-floor staff

**Attributes we care about most:**

- High ownership: treats the quality of every dispatched item as personally their responsibility

- Ability to work independently: doesn't need to be chased, and can run inspections and documentation end to end

- Integrity and the courage to say no: holds the line on quality even when deadlines or production pressure push back

- Attention to detail: notices the small defect or missing record that others overlook

- Proactive, not reactive: prevents problems through checks and root cause fixes instead of only reporting them afterwards

- Clear communicator: able to explain defects, standards and corrective actions to the shop floor, vendors and customers alike

- Process-minded and well organised: keeps records so tidy that any order can be traced and defended

- Team player with a teaching mindset: builds quality awareness in the people around them

**What We Oﬀer:**

* Real ownership of quality in a company with a track record going back to 1977, and direct visibility to management
* Varied, technically meaningful work across FRP, PP, HDPE and MS-FRP lined equipment for many industries
* A stable, collaborative work culture with room to grow into a quality leadership role
* Scope to improve systems, build better processes and see the impact of your work
* The chance to contribute to cleaner air and safer industrial operations

**Work Schedule:**

Day shift: 9:15 AM to 6:30 PM

Monday to Saturday

Occasional extended hours during project deadlines

Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Manager Testing MV AIS Panels
description:
Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions. Looking for a challenging role?

**If you really want to make a difference, make it with us!**

**Job Summary**

Lead and oversee Quality Control and testing operations for Medium Voltage (MV) Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) panels, ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards, electrical safety regulations, and customer specifications. The role involves technical leadership, team management, quality assurance, testing operations, continuous improvement, and customer coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate testing activities for MV AIS panels, typically in the 3.3 kV to 36 kV range.
* Review and approve test procedures, protocols, and test reports.
* Analyze test results and troubleshoot complex technical issues during testing.
* Ensure adherence to technical specifications and applicable testing standards.

**2. Team Management**

* Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of test engineers and technicians.
* Allocate resources and schedule testing activities to achieve operational targets.
* Conduct performance evaluations and identify training requirements.
* Ensure adherence to safety procedures while maintaining team productivity and morale, particularly during high-pressure situations.

**3. Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with relevant IEC, IEEE, and other applicable standards.
* Maintain testing equipment calibration, accuracy, and reliability.
* Implement quality control measures and validate testing documentation.
* Monitor monthly Factory Routine Test (FRT) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) data and publish key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Collect and analyze error data and provide feedback to relevant departments to improve engineering inputs, drawings, and vendor workmanship.
* Monitor and control post-dispatch non-conformities (NCC) and site complaints within defined limits.
* Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.

**4. Project and Customer Management**

* Coordinate with project managers to align testing schedules with project requirements.
* Monitor testing progress, resource utilization, budgets, and timelines.
* Coordinate with customers during witness testing and Factory Acceptance Tests.
* Ensure timely completion of testing activities and resolution of technical issues.

**5. Audits and Compliance**

* Participate in internal and external ISO audits, EHS audits, Energy Management System (EnMS) audits, and factory approval audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems and audit requirements.
* Maintain accurate testing and quality documentation.

**6. Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)**

* Ensure EHS compliance across shop-floor testing activities.
* Maintain records of safety training for testing engineers and technicians.
* Maintain safety and compliance documentation for service providers.
* Ensure adherence to Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), Permit to Work (PTW), Toolbox Talks (TBT), and Last-Minute Risk Assessment (LMRA) processes.
* Promote electrical safety, arc-flash awareness, and safe working practices.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Additional certifications in switchgear testing are preferred.

**Experience**

* 8–16 years of experience in MV switchgear testing.
* 3–5 years of experience in a team leadership or supervisory role.
* Strong background in electrical power distribution systems.

**Technical Skills**

* Expertise in MV switchgear testing procedures and protocols.
* Hands-on experience with electrical testing equipment and tools.
* Knowledge of IEC 62271, IEEE C37 series, and other relevant standards.
* Understanding of protection relay systems and switchgear control schemes.
* Experience in test documentation, reporting, and data analysis.

**Leadership and Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong team leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines under pressure.

**Safety Requirements**

* Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and arc-flash safety protocols.
* Advanced electrical safety certification preferred.
* First aid and emergency response training preferred.
* Familiarity with electrical safety work permits and safe working procedures.

**Additional Requirements**

* Willingness to travel for customer witness testing when required.
* Flexibility to work extended hours based on operational requirements.
* Proficiency in test report documentation and analysis tools.

**About Us**

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, in over 200 countries. We’re dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

title: Lead Error Manager
description:
**What's the role?**

You will define the business and process requirements for workflows, fields, templates, dashboards and integrations. * Define operational KPIs, SLA requirements, dashboards and management reporting for defect flows and process health.

* BS or MS in Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field

**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. **About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

**Job Description**
**Purpose:**
The Vision CQ Transportation Quality Specialist - APAC & Japan provides quality oversight and subject-matter support for inter-regional transportation activities impacting APAC and Japan. The role helps ensure that transportation operations meet applicable quality, regulatory and business requirements and that transportation risks and issues are managed effectively.
  
  
Working within Vision Commercial Quality, the position collaborates with regional and global stakeholders, internal functions and external partners to support compliant, reliable and continually improving transportation processes.
  
  
The role also supports governance through the provision of Vision-specific information and, where required, contributes to cross-segment transportation investigations with MedTech and Innovative Medicine while retaining accountability for Vision activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide operational quality oversight for inter-regional transportation activities impacting APAC and Japan, partnering with regional Commercial Quality, Transportation Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, carriers, control towers and logistics providers.
* Lead or support transportation-related investigations, nonconformances, CAPAs, deviations, change controls, complaints, product-impact assessments, effectiveness checks and associated quality records through timely closure.
* Assess and coordinate the resolution of transportation incidents, temperature excursions, damage, contamination, losses, mis-deliveries, seal issues and service failures; escalate material risks in accordance with established processes.
* Support transportation supplier quality activities, including carrier qualification, quality agreements, supplier audits, performance reviews, corrective-action follow-up and remediation.
* Support transportation lane and route qualification, lane mapping, shipping-route verification, transportation risk assessments, temperature-control qualification and network changes.
* Provide quality support for new product introductions, transfers, business-continuity activities and other projects that change transportation routes, providers, systems or operating processes.
* Build, maintain and report transportation quality metrics, dashboards, scorecards and trend analyses; identify emerging risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and retrievable documentation and evidence packages to support internal audits, supplier audits, health authority inspections and notified-body assessments.
* Contributes to process simplification, harmonization, training, communications and capability-building initiatives as transportation responsibilities transition into Vision CQ.
* Prepare and validate Vision-specific transportation quality data, metrics, trend analyses, risks and investigation insights for use in governance meetings and management reviews.
* Provide clear Vision-specific supporting information and subject-matter input in response to governance requests, ensuring that Vision transportation issues, trends and regulatory considerations are accurately represented.
* On occasion, work with MedTech and Innovative Medicine quality colleagues on cross-segment transportation investigations, contributing Vision-specific evidence, product and lane impact assessments, root-cause input and agreed follow-up activities.
* Provide technical quality guidance, support workflow execution and contribute to departmental transportation quality priorities; this position has no direct supervisory responsibility.

**Qulifications**
**Experience & Education**

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree is required.
* Degree concentration in Life Science, Engineering, Technical Business, Quality, Regulatory Compliance, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Minimum five years of experience in a regulated healthcare industry, including medical devices, pharmaceuticals and/or diagnostics, with quality, regulatory compliance, distribution, supplier quality coordination, transportation or supply chain quality experience.
* Experience supporting transportation quality operations, investigations, CAPAs, quality events, change controls, metrics reporting, trend analysis and cross-functional project activities.
* Demonstrated knowledge of applicable global regulations and experience collaborating with professionals in a matrixed environment.
* Experience supporting transportation qualification, supplier quality activities, new product introductions, network changes, remediation and/or quality improvement activities is preferred.
* Experience preparing accurate operational quality data, metrics, trends and risk information for governance or management review, and collaborating across functions on shared investigations or issue resolution.
* Previous experience supporting audits or interfacing with regulatory agencies and notified bodies is preferred.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Certifications/licenses And Affiliations**

* Working knowledge of transportation quality management, Good Distribution Practices, quality management systems, supplier quality coordination, carrier performance, qualification activities, issue escalation and compliant logistics operations.
* Knowledge of lane and route qualification, lane mapping, temperature-controlled transportation, temperature excursion management, transportation risk assessment and logistics-provider oversight.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Transportation Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, APAC and Japan regional Commercial Quality teams and external suppliers in a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use metrics, scorecards and trends to identify risk and drive action.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, influencing and presentation skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility across Quality and Compliance, Supply Chain, Commercial and external partner organizations.
* Ability to zoom in and out across strategic, tactical, high-level and detailed perspectives; manage multiple priorities; make complex topics clear; and operate effectively in an ambiguous environment.
* Ability to prepare clear, accurate and decision-ready Vision-specific data for governance review and to collaborate effectively with MedTech and Innovative Medicine colleagues when supporting occasional cross-segment transportation investigations.
* Fluent English and Japanese language capability are required, with the ability to communicate effectively with Japan-based stakeholders and support the review or coordination of Japan-related transportation quality documentation.
* Quality auditing, GDP, project management, supply chain, logistics, Lean or Six Sigma certification is desirable.

**Location & Travel requirements:**

* Location is flexible subject to business and employment requirements, with the ability to support stakeholders across APAC and Japan time zones.
* Travel of approximately 15–25% may be required, depending on business needs, including regional meetings, supplier or carrier engagements, audits, qualification activities, project support and site visits.
* The role requires effective remote collaboration across a global, cross-functional and multicultural organization.

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Audit Management, Business Savvy, Coaching, Communication, Compliance Management, Continuous Improvement, Fact-Based Decision Making, ISO 9001, Issue Escalation, Problem Solving, Quality Control (QC), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Quality Standards, Regulatory Environment, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

Job Title: QAQC Inspector

Experience- 5 to 10 Years

Salary-7.00 to 9.00 LPA

Job Location-Vasai, Maharashtra

**About the company**
- Our client, is a Mumbai-based company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and supply of high-quality safety and edge-protection systems for the construction industry. Established in 2019, the company has quickly built a strong reputation for delivering innovative and reliable solutions that enhance safety and efficiency on high-rise construction sites across India.

The companys core offerings include safety screen systems, vertical safety net systems, loading platforms, walkway planks, fan netting systems, and other customized safety products designed to meet the evolving needs of modern construction. It works closely with leading real estate developers, contractors, and project management teams to ensure world-class safety standards are maintained on every site.

**About the Role**

They are looking for an experienced QA/QC Inspector to ensure the quality of raw materials, manufacturing processes, fabricated components, and finished products. The candidate will be responsible for conducting inspections, maintaining quality records, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring that products meet the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Inspect raw materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products to ensure they meet quality standards.
* Set quality standards and prepare approved samples for reference.
* Maintain the calibration schedule for measuring instruments and ensure timely calibration through NABL-accredited laboratories.
* Conduct visual and dimensional inspections using measuring tools such as Vernier calipers, measuring tapes, and dry film thickness meters.
* Perform non-destructive testing (NDT), including Dye Penetrant Testing (DPT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MPT), and hammer tests on fabricated components.
* Check the production and readiness status of components against the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and update the Production Manager.
* Approve the quality of components before finished products are dispatched from the factory.
* Maintain in-process inspection reports and final inspection records.
* Conduct quality training on welding, hot-dip galvanizing, powder coating, epoxy coating, and enamel painting procedures.
* Conduct periodic quality audits at manufacturing plants and report non-conformities and areas for improvement to senior management.
* Identify quality issues and implement corrective actions to prevent them from recurring.
* Visit fabrication and finishing vendors to inspect their work, monitor performance, and suggest improvements.
* Prepare monthly quality reports (MIS) for management.
* Implement and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) as per ISO 9001:2015 standards.
* Prepare and implement Quality Assurance Plans, Inspection Test Plans (ITP), and Material Test Plans.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma/Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* ASNT Level II certification in DPT and MPT.

**Required Experience**

* Experience working in a manufacturing industry or medium-sized fabrication plant as a Fabrication Engineer.
* Experience in Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA).
* Practical knowledge of fabrication inspection, welding quality, surface finishing, dimensional inspection, and non-destructive testing.

title: Senior Specialist - R&D Quality
description:
**Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a**
Senior Specialist - R&D Quality
  
  
**What We Do**
At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.
  
  
**Role Reports To**
Manager, R&D Q&C
  
  
**Location:**
Asia Pacific, India, Maharashtra, Greater Mumbai
  
  
**Work Location:**
Fully Onsite
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**What you will do**
The Senior Specialist, R&D Quality provides strategic quality oversight and compliance leadership across R&D Analytical, Microbiology, Stability, and Product Development functions. The role is responsible for ensuring adherence to Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, global regulatory expectations, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and data integrity principles. This position partners with cross-functional stakeholders to manage investigations, CAPAs, supplier quality programs, laboratory compliance, audit readiness, computerized system validation, and stability quality activities while driving continuous improvement and quality culture across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Stability Quality Oversight**
Provide quality oversight for stability programs supporting
**Self Care and Food product portfolios.**
Review Stability Protocols, Stability Reports, Stability Closeout Reports, and associated documentation to ensure compliance with internal procedures, regulatory requirements, and scientific standards. Lead and support stability transformation initiatives to improve processes, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Investigation, CAPA & Quality Risk Management**
Lead end-to-end management of laboratory investigations, deviations, and quality events. Facilitate root cause analysis, risk assessments, effectiveness verification, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Ensure timely closure of investigations and CAPAs while maintaining compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Analytical Quality & Product Development Support**
Provide quality review for Method Validation reports, Test Method reviews, Technical Justifications, analytical protocols, and study reports supporting Self Care and Food products. Ensure scientifically sound analytical practices and regulatory compliance throughout product development and lifecycle management activities. Support TMV, Development Protocols, Stability Protocols, Study Reports, and Sample Release activities.
  
  
**Microbiology Laboratory Quality Oversight**
Provide end-to-end quality oversight of microbiology laboratory operations, including compliance monitoring, investigations, documentation review, training support, and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure laboratory activities remain inspection-ready and aligned with corporate quality standards.
  
  
**Laboratory Compliance & Operational Excellence**
Drive laboratory compliance through routine assessments, laboratory rounds, and Gemba Walks. Monitor adherence to SOPs, data integrity requirements, GLP, GDP, and quality procedures. Identify compliance risks, implement corrective actions, and promote operational excellence across laboratory functions
  
  
**Supplier Quality Management**
Lead Auditor for supplier qualification, monitoring, and audit programs for raw material suppliers, contract laboratories, and CDMOs. Conduct supplier audits, assess supplier performance, manage quality agreements, and ensure suppliers consistently meet quality, regulatory, and business requirements for Food, Self Care, and Essential Health products.
  
  
**Audit & Inspection Readiness**
Serve as a key quality representative during internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections. Support audit planning, observation management, CAPA implementation, and inspection readiness activities to ensure sustained compliance across R&D operations.
  
  
**Documentation & Records Management**
Provide oversight of document control and records management processes. Review, approve, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, forms, protocols, reports, and quality records. Ensure compliance with GDP requirements and effective lifecycle management of controlled documents and records.
  
  
**Computer System Validation & Digital Quality**
Support validation and lifecycle management of computerized laboratory and quality systems. Review validation documentation, protocols, test scripts, and reports to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Support Veeva deployment, electronic learning management systems, and digital quality initiatives to enhance compliance and efficiency.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance Assessment**
Monitor emerging regulations, industry guidelines, and quality requirements impacting R&D activities. Conduct regulatory impact assessments and support implementation of regulatory changes to ensure ongoing compliance and proactive risk management.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance, R&D Quality, Laboratory Compliance, Analytical Sciences, or regulated laboratory environments.
* Strong expertise in QMS, Investigations, CAPA, Supplier Quality, Audit Management, Data Integrity, and Regulatory Compliance.
* Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV), Veeva Vault, Electronic Learning Management Systems (ELM), and electronic quality systems.
* Strong understanding of GLP, GDP, GMP, regulatory requirements, and inspection readiness practices.
* Must have Lead Auditor Certification & experience in conducting audits of suppliers and Contract Laboratories
* Must have faced regulatory audits like USFDA, EUGMP & WHO etc.

**Job Description**
 The Global Supplier Services (GSS) Quality Assurance (QA) function, a sub\-function within CAO Controls Management, performs end\-to\-end assurance reviews across the GSS lifecycle to proactively identify and assess operational risks, validate that controls are designed and operating effectively, and confirm processes are robust and sustainable.
   

  

 In this role, you will execute end\-to\-end QA review activities (including testing strategy, execution, analysis, and management reporting) and support risk\-based planning/scoping to help mitigate the risk of errors and provide ongoing assurance to management.
   

  

* Participate in QA reviews end\-to\-end, including developing testing strategies, executing testing, and analyzing results.
* Support the delivery of targeted thematic reviews aligned to regulatory commitments, business priorities and emerging risk themes.
* Execute control and process testing across critical process steps, data elements, and key operational risk points within the GSS lifecycle.
* Obtain, organize, and evaluate supporting documentation to evidence what was tested and how conclusions were reached; maintain audit\-ready workpapers that stand alone for secondary review.
* Identify exceptions, perform preliminary root cause analysis, and draft clear, supportable documentation for review leads and stakeholder discussions.
* Support risk\-based planning and scoping through population review and analytics to identify anomalies and inform sample selection.
* Participate in walkthroughs with stakeholders and support audit\-ready documentation and control rationalization.
* Analyze program\-related data (e.g., KPI/KRI) and contribute to insightful reporting that supports risk and control priorities.

 Successful candidates demonstrate strong analytical judgment, clear audit\-ready writing, and the ability to evaluate evidence and reach well\-supported conclusions while partnering effectively with stakeholders.
   

  

* 1\-2 years related experience in controls, audit, quality assurance, risk management, or compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to understand requirements quickly, evaluate evidence, and document conclusions clearly.
* Basic understanding of statistical and risk\-based sample methodologies and their application with quality assurance testing.
* Strong verbal and written communications, including the ability to produce clear, concise, well\-supported documentation.
* Strong organization skills; ability to multi\-task and prioritize deliverables across multiple workstreams.
